About

THE DESIGNER

I'm Bividh Oli — a graphic designer based in Kathmandu with a passion for bold visuals and purposeful design. From brand identities to event posters, I work where concept meets craft.

My toolkit is the Adobe Creative Suite — Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects are my daily tools. I believe great design isn't just seen; it's felt.
